verification: The census gate wrote and signed data/census.json before checking it, then would have raised (blocking the afterok fit array) if fewer than 10 classes qualified; it did not raise. 13 classes qualified in all 3 splits. The analyze stage's built-in guard refit the all-class support surface from exp-5's stored grid predictions and exp-6's full-feature ICC and compared its point b = gamma_e * ln2 against exp-6's own analysis.json:surfaces.full.b.point within 1e-6; the job did not raise, confirming the reimplemented surface refit reproduces exp-6 exactly on the unrestricted class set before it is applied to the site-class-restricted grid. No classifier used in the guard or the grid refit was retrained; both read exp-5's/exp-6's stored predictions and correlations only. The 45 new fits (3 allocations x 3 splits x 5 draws) trained fresh multinomial logistic models on the sampled site allocations.
run_summary: census: for each split, grouped eligible (>=32-patch) TCGA-UT patients by tissue-source-site code and kept classes whose site pool has >=10 sites in every split (13 of 30). fit: for each (split, allocation) shard and each of 5 draws, sampled the deep/broad5/broad10 site allocations (nested per Eq. nesting) plus shared fixed background classes, tuned and fit a multinomial logistic classifier, and wrote its run record. analyze: loaded the 45 new fits' and the reused 27 exp-5 grid fits' stored test predictions under the same paired Bayesian bootstrap context (2000 replicates, row 0 = unweighted observed) as exp-5/exp-6, reordered each split's per-class recalls into one canonical class order, restricted patient-macro recall to the 13 site classes, refit the support surface on the site-class grid (correlations fixed at their exp-6 full-feature point estimate) per bootstrap replicate, computed A_D/A_5/A_10, the site gain Delta_S = A_10 - A_5, the within-site residual b_W (Eq. within-site), and classified both against the +-1pp threshold.
reporting_notes: Site-class-restricted accuracy (%, patient-macro balanced, mean of 15 split-draw points): deep 56.36 [55.18, 57.57], broad5 69.88 [68.62, 71.17], broad10 70.94 [69.71, 72.21]; all-30-class accuracy alongside: deep 65.01, broad5 68.50, broad10 68.86.
Site gain Delta_S = 1.06pp, 95% CI [0.74, 1.37] -- crosses the 1pp threshold.
Within-site residual b_W = 3.31pp per doubling, 95% CI [2.71, 3.84] -- interval lies entirely above 1pp.
Reference residual b_ref (site classes, sites not controlled) = 1.21pp, 95% CI [0.63, 1.79]; b_W - b_ref = 2.10pp, 95% CI [1.77, 2.40], both intervals excluding zero.

Refitted site-class surface: beta_hat = 5.37 [4.63, 6.14] (log-Neff slope), gamma_hat = 1.75 [0.91, 2.58] (log-G slope); Neff(5,32) = 10.36, Neff(20,8) = 37.44 on the site-class subset. First step raw 13.52 [13.05, 14.03], explained by effective support 6.90 [5.94, 7.89].

Interpretation label: inconclusive. Delta_S crosses the 1pp threshold (does not sit entirely above it), so neither the site_coverage nor the both reading is established, even though b_W alone clears the threshold.

Split-draw spread (descriptive): site gain per split-draw fit mean 1.06, SD 1.70, range -1.86 to 4.96, positive in 11 of 15, split means 0.72/0.39/2.06; raw first step A_5 - A_D mean 13.52, SD 2.45, range 7.13 to 17.12, positive in 15 of 15.

Strata (descriptive, patient-share weighted pooling): added +3.93 (positive in 13 of 13 classes), core -1.53 (negative in 11), other +0.67 (positive in 9); shares 31/32/37%; contributions 1.26/-0.48/0.25 of pooled class gain 1.04.

Class-order fix (commit a77a38c): analyses before job 4886173 used split 0's class order for all three splits' stored labels, misattributing site-class recalls in splits 1-2. All site-class quantities, surface refit on the site-class grid, draw contrasts for splits 1-2, and strata changed; all-class accuracies and split-0 draw contrasts are unchanged.

Grid-step diagnostic (exploratory, not prespecified; jobs 4886185 and 4886196, script outputs/tcga_ut/patch/diag/gridstep.py on Hydra, reusing sites.fitting.prepare/_grid_fit/_allocation_fit/_contrasts under the same paired bootstrap): site-class raw grid step (5,32)->(20,8) = 9.30 [8.73, 9.92] vs surface prediction 9.33 (difference -0.03 [-0.08, 0.02]); b_grid = 1.20 [0.62, 1.77] vs b_ref 1.21; b_W - b_grid = 2.11 [1.79, 2.41]; deep allocation minus grid (5,32) = -3.70 [-4.27, -3.11], negative in 13 of 15 fits; broad5 minus grid (20,8) = 0.52 [0.02, 1.03], negative in 5 of 15; broad10 minus grid (20,8) = 1.58 [1.08, 2.07]. Written to tcga_ut/grid_step.json; the job reproduced analysis.json's b_W, b_ref, and Delta_S points exactly.
